ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (Agreement") is made as of the 1_ day of December, 2023 by and between 345 Bergen Condo LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 224 Franklin Avenue, Suite 14, Hewlett, NY 11557 ("Owner") and Bergen Owner LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, c/o Avdoo & Partners Development LLC, 221 West 37"h Street, 5"h Floor,New York,NY 10018("Developer") 1. WITNESSETH: 2. WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee of certain land,with the building and improvements thereon, in the Borough of Brooklyn, City and State of New York, generally known by the street address 345 Bergen Street, New York, designated as Lot 46 in Block 198 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Kings (the “Tax Map") and more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto (said land being herein called the “Owner Land,” said building and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted in accordance with this Agreement, being herein called the “Owner Building,” and the Owner Land and the Owner Building being herein collectively called the “Owner Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee title of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the Borough of Brooklyn, City and State of New York, generally known by the street addresses 323 Bergen Street, Brooklyn, New York, (also known as 311-343 Bergen Street, Brooklyn, New York) designated as Lot 48 in Block 198 on the Tax Map and more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto (said land being herein collectively called the “Developer Land,” said building and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof Building,” and the Developer Land and the Developer Building being herein collectively called the “Developer Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct one or more new buildings (each, a “New Developer Building") upon Developer Land, with a bulk that would be in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on Developer Land under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), if the Developer Land was considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; WHEREAS, there are certain “Floor Area Development Rights" (as hereinafter defined) appurtenant to the Owner Land that are in excess of the “Owner Retained Floor Area Development Rights" (as hereinafter defined) and that are available for transfer in accordance with the Zoning Resolution (the“Excess Floor Area Development Rights"); WHEREAS, it is contemplated that New Developer Building will contain more floor area than is now available for use on Developer Premises pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and the partiesheretothereforedesiretoutilizetheprocedure availablepursuant totheZoningResolution to enlarge the Zoning Lot and create the“Combined Zoning Lot”(ashereinafter defined) so as to make available a portion of the Lot 46 Floor Area Development Rights for use in connection with the construction and maintenance of the New Developer Building, and Owner is willing to make 2 RMANDEL/14962.0001/4383416.2
